def locate_avg(name, n=3):
    xs, ys = [], []

        if not r.ok:
            raise SystemExit(r.text)
        xs.append(r.data["x"]); ys.append(r.data["y"])

def locate_avg(name, n=3):
    xs, ys = [], []
    for i in range(n):
        r = workcell.robot("locate", name)
        if not r.ok:
            raise SystemExit(r.text)
        xs.append(r.data["x"]); ys.append(r.data["y"])
